description: This file contains classes and methods for reading, writing, and managing Visual Studio project files, including tools, filters, configurations, and files sections, with methods to add and serialize project data.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio tool with a method to generate its XML representation.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio filter (virtual folder) with contained items.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: Handles creation and modification of Visual Studio project files, including adding files, configurations, and writing the project XML.
